thread:
jamie: heads up — noticed heatmap frames spike (~800ms->1.3s) after yesterday's routing-policy tweak. charts block on metric calls.
alex: yup saw it on prod canary. looks like the metrics API cold path is hitting a quota throttle then retrying. request waterfall shows a 429 then a fast retry loop.
priya: can you paste the waterfall? iirc we changed route affinity to prefer eu-durable nodes which have higher p99 on that endpoint.
alex: pasted — here's the snippet from the browser devtools network timeline:

```
GET /api/v1/metrics/query?series=heatmap  200ms
GET /api/v1/metric-pipe/stream       429 (QuotaExceeded)
POST /api/v1/metric-pipe/retry        1200ms
```

serge: telemetry shows a sudden sample-rate increase for metric-pipe events at 03:14 — that would push more traffic into the slow cold path. i rolled a quick trace and saw many requests miss the KV cache.
jamie: so two factors: routing affinity moved traffic to eu-durable, and telemetry sampling bumped requests through a cold pipeline that isn't warmed. together they push the chart rendering into blocking waits.
luis: agree. i can flip the affinity back to multi-region fallback for the canary. suggestion: temporary reduce telemetry sample for metric-pipe to lower load while we hotspot the cold path.
priya: short-term rollback sounds good. also can we add a tiny client-side debounce for heatmap requests so a burst of route changes doesn't trigger N requests? 100ms dedupe would help.
alex: i'll open a tiny PR for client debounce + defensive retry jitter. serge — can you put a telemetry patch to roll sample-rate down to previous value? maybe from 10% -> 1%.
serge: done (canary config updated). deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by @luis — routing-affinity reverted to previous policy. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary at 3/3 healthy. no errors in last 5m.

jamie: after rollback the heatmap frames are back to ~200-350ms on canary. keeping an eye. thanks all :thumbsup:
priya: follow-ups: (1) instrument KV warmups on metric-pipe startup, (2) plan autoscale for telemetry ingestion so sampling tweaks don't amplify cold starts, (3) client debounce PR review.
luis: i'll create tracking tickets for those items and put them into next sprint. good catch everyone.
